title: Tour de Monserrat
text: Alejandro is a wonderful and very personable guide. He was on time and made the experience very enjoyable despite the rainy weather. We took in the scenery at Montserrat (Catalonia, Spain) and rode the Funicular de Sant Joan and Santa Cova.  We were able to adjust our plans as needed. It was truly our personal tour. If you're in Barcelona and need a personal guided tour, request Alejandro with Viator.
author: 784rodicat

title: Breathtaking Spiritual Experience
text: What an amazing experience! First of all, our guide, Alex, was extremely knowledgeable and very attentive. He gave us an in-depth history of the monastery and the grounds. I was overwhelmed by its beauty and sense of spirituality experienced during the tour. Definitely ride the funicular or hike up to experience the monastery from above! It is very easy to spend an entire day on the grounds. One of the best experiences in Europe!
author: Carol_M

title: Nature AND nice tour
text: What a wonderful day! Alejandro picked us up from our hotel and it started off rainy and was quite cold on top of the mountain. It made for such a special day because there were few people there and Alejandro took so many wonderful pics of us and suggested extra time hiking since the weather cleared up. We saw amazing sights and everything ended on a perfect note. Everyone should do this tour.
author: C8559GPcarolines

title: A great tour.
text: After a very prompt pick-up of all the participants, we were taken by Alejandro in a very comfortable van to Montserrat. Alejandro was a very professional and safe driver. He worked hard to get us into the basilica before a funeral that closed it to the public. So grateful he got us there in time. We watched many groups get turned away as we were ending our tour. No complaints, would definitely recommend. Like all tours, there just never seems to be enough time. Alejandro shared history, geologic, makeup, and church tradition with all of us.
author: vrmccann
